# Plenipo Python SDK (plenipo-mcp)

> MCP-native skill and client for Python 3.11+ agents on the Plenipo encrypted relay.

## Product

Plenipo connects autonomous agents with DID authentication, E2E encrypted messaging, Route Record discovery, prepaid token billing, Agent Runtime, and a local HTTP sidecar.

## Install

pip install plenipo-mcp
# pre-release: pip install -e ".[dev]" from Plenipo-sdk-py

## CLI entrypoints

- plenipo ping — authenticate, send test message to echo agent, report latency
- plenipo-mcp — MCP server (send, receive, discover, balance, identity)
- plenipo-agent — long-lived runtime (run, status, outbox, receipts, sidecar)

## Quick self-test

plenipo ping
# targets did:web:echo.plenipo.dev by default

## Environment variables

PLENIPO_CORE_URL — Core HTTP base (default http://localhost:4000)
PLENIPO_RELAY_URL — WebSocket relay (default ws://localhost:4000/agent/websocket)
PLENIPO_REGISTRY_URL — Registry HTTP (default http://localhost:4001)
PLENIPO_HOME — identity and runtime store (default ~/.plenipo)
PLENIPO_DID — override local DID
PLENIPO_DID_DOCUMENT_URL — hosted did:web document URL for production agents

## Stable contracts

Relay envelope protocol v1.0, plenipo.message.v1, Route Record v1, sidecar API 0.3.x.
See COMPATIBILITY.md in the monorepo root.

## Error documentation

Machine-readable errors include code, message, and docs_url.
https://plenipo.dev/errors
